arStrings.szText: As ever, the Tree would see its debts repaid.
Ouna tried to unmake her mistakes, but the Tree would not forgive her. Some of the heads she stole have been restored to the Tree—hers included.  I should see how the Coven is holding up.
Ouna risked the lives of all who were tainted by the heads' rot. Yet, her actions were born of love for those who raised her. I should say goodbye, one last time.
